verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a SaaS auth service, but the evidence pack has no documented natural-language command interface, AI assistant, or agent for operating Supabase Auth. The llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI probes are machine-readable building blocks that could help someone build such an interface. They are not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
